label: Functional + Mock Vent
description: Functional plus mock vent combines working buttonholes at the cuff with one or two extra non-functional button positions beyond the operative ones — creating an elongated row of buttons that appears more dramatic than standard surgeon's cuffs while retaining genuine functionality at the critical buttons. This is a collector's detail, signalling both technical knowledge and a refined sense of sleeve proportion. It is occasionally seen on jackets with five or six-button sleeves where the uppermost positions are purely aesthetic.
